panels.description: Validates data quality metrics for all chart types

targets.queryText: SELECT 'Date Coverage' as metric, COUNT(*) as total_events, COUNT(Date) as events_with_dates, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(Date) / COUNT(*), 1) as coverage_percentage FROM EventTable UNION ALL SELECT 'Coordinate Coverage' as metric, COUNT(*) as total_places, COUNT(Latitude) as places_with_coords, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(Latitude) / COUNT(*), 1) as coverage_percentage FROM PlaceTable UNION ALL SELECT 'Citation Coverage' as metric, COUNT(*) as total_sources, COUNT(DISTINCT ct.SourceID) as sources_with_citations, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ct.SourceID) / COUNT(*), 1) as coverage_percentage FROM SourceTable st LEFT JOIN CitationTable ct ON ct.SourceID = st.SourceID UNION ALL SELECT 'Name Coverage' as metric, COUNT(DISTINCT p.PersonID) as total_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT n.OwnerID) as persons_with_names, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT n.OwnerID) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.PersonID), 1) as coverage_percentage FROM PersonTable p LEFT JOIN NameTable n ON n.OwnerID = p.PersonID AND n.IsPrimary = 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 'Date Coverage' as metric, COUNT(*) as total_events, COUNT(Date) as events_with_dates, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(Date) / COUNT(*), 1) as coverage_percentage FROM EventTable UNION ALL SELECT 'Coordinate Coverage' as metric, COUNT(*) as total_places, COUNT(Latitude) as places_with_coords, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(Latitude) / COUNT(*), 1) as coverage_percentage FROM PlaceTable UNION ALL SELECT 'Citation Coverage' as metric, COUNT(*) as total_sources, COUNT(DISTINCT ct.SourceID) as sources_with_citations, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ct.SourceID) / COUNT(*), 1) as coverage_percentage FROM SourceTable st LEFT JOIN CitationTable ct ON ct.SourceID = st.SourceID UNION ALL SELECT 'Name Coverage' as metric, COUNT(DISTINCT p.PersonID) as total_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT n.OwnerID) as persons_with_names, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT n.OwnerID) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.PersonID), 1) as coverage_percentage FROM PersonTable p LEFT JOIN NameTable n ON n.OwnerID = p.PersonID AND n.IsPrimary = 1

panels.title: Data Quality Metrics

panels.description: Tests heatmap data format: x (decade), y (month), value (birth count)

targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%Y', e.Date) as decade, CAST(strftime('%m', e.Date) AS INTEGER) as month, COUNT(*) as birth_count FROM EventTable e WHERE e.EventType = 1 AND e.Date IS NOT NULL AND e.Date != '' GROUP BY decade, month ORDER BY decade, month
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%Y', e.Date) as decade, CAST(strftime('%m', e.Date) AS INTEGER) as month, COUNT(*) as birth_count FROM EventTable e WHERE e.EventType = 1 AND e.Date IS NOT NULL AND e.Date != '' GROUP BY decade, month ORDER BY decade, month

panels.title: TEST: Heatmap - Birth Seasonality

panels.description: Tests geomap data format: latitude, longitude, value, label

targets.queryText: SELECT p.Latitude, p.Longitude, COUNT(DISTINCT e.OwnerID) as person_count, p.PlaceName as location FROM PlaceTable p JOIN EventTable e ON e.PlaceID = p.PlaceID WHERE p.Latitude IS NOT NULL AND p.Longitude IS NOT NULL AND p.Latitude != 0 AND p.Longitude != 0 GROUP BY p.PlaceID HAVING person_count > 0 ORDER BY person_count DESC LIMIT 50
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT p.Latitude, p.Longitude, COUNT(DISTINCT e.OwnerID) as person_count, p.PlaceName as location FROM PlaceTable p JOIN EventTable e ON e.PlaceID = p.PlaceID WHERE p.Latitude IS NOT NULL AND p.Longitude IS NOT NULL AND p.Latitude != 0 AND p.Longitude != 0 GROUP BY p.PlaceID HAVING person_count > 0 ORDER BY person_count DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: TEST: Bubble Map - Geographic Distribution

panels.description: Tests Sankey data format: source, target, value (flow count)

targets.queryText: WITH person_places AS (SELECT p.PersonID, birth_place.PlaceName as birth_place, death_place.PlaceName as death_place FROM PersonTable p LEFT JOIN EventTable birth ON birth.OwnerID = p.PersonID AND birth.EventType = 1 LEFT JOIN EventTable death ON death.OwnerID = p.PersonID AND death.EventType = 2 LEFT JOIN PlaceTable birth_place ON birth.PlaceID = birth_place.PlaceID LEFT JOIN PlaceTable death_place ON death.PlaceID = death_place.PlaceID WHERE birth_place.PlaceName IS NOT NULL AND death_place.PlaceName IS NOT NULL AND birth_place.PlaceName != death_place.PlaceName) SELECT birth_place as source, death_place as target, COUNT(*) as flow_count FROM person_places GROUP BY birth_place, death_place HAVING flow_count >= 2 ORDER BY flow_count DESC LIMIT 50
targets.rawQueryText: WITH person_places AS (SELECT p.PersonID, birth_place.PlaceName as birth_place, death_place.PlaceName as death_place FROM PersonTable p LEFT JOIN EventTable birth ON birth.OwnerID = p.PersonID AND birth.EventType = 1 LEFT JOIN EventTable death ON death.OwnerID = p.PersonID AND death.EventType = 2 LEFT JOIN PlaceTable birth_place ON birth.PlaceID = birth_place.PlaceID LEFT JOIN PlaceTable death_place ON death.PlaceID = death_place.PlaceID WHERE birth_place.PlaceName IS NOT NULL AND death_place.PlaceName IS NOT NULL AND birth_place.PlaceName != death_place.PlaceName) SELECT birth_place as source, death_place as target, COUNT(*) as flow_count FROM person_places GROUP BY birth_place, death_place HAVING flow_count >= 2 ORDER BY flow_count DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: TEST: Sankey - Migration Flows

panels.description: Tests Chord data format: source, target, value (marriage count)

targets.queryText: SELECT father_name.Surname as source, mother_name.Surname as target, COUNT(*) as marriage_count FROM FamilyTable f JOIN NameTable father_name ON father_name.OwnerID = f.FatherID AND father_name.IsPrimary = 1 JOIN NameTable mother_name ON mother_name.OwnerID = f.MotherID AND mother_name.IsPrimary = 1 WHERE father_name.Surname IS NOT NULL AND mother_name.Surname IS NOT NULL AND father_name.Surname != mother_name.Surname AND f.FatherID IS NOT NULL AND f.MotherID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY father_name.Surname, mother_name.Surname HAVING marriage_count >= 2 ORDER BY marriage_count DESC LIMIT 30
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT father_name.Surname as source, mother_name.Surname as target, COUNT(*) as marriage_count FROM FamilyTable f JOIN NameTable father_name ON father_name.OwnerID = f.FatherID AND father_name.IsPrimary = 1 JOIN NameTable mother_name ON mother_name.OwnerID = f.MotherID AND mother_name.IsPrimary = 1 WHERE father_name.Surname IS NOT NULL AND mother_name.Surname IS NOT NULL AND father_name.Surname != mother_name.Surname AND f.FatherID IS NOT NULL AND f.MotherID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY father_name.Surname, mother_name.Surname HAVING marriage_count >= 2 ORDER BY marriage_count DESC LIMIT 30

panels.description: Tests Treemap data format: hierarchy path, value

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN st.TemplateID = 0 THEN 'Free-Form Citations' ELSE 'Template-Based Citations' END || ' > ' || CASE WHEN st.Name LIKE '%Census%' THEN 'Census Records' WHEN st.Name LIKE '%Birth%' OR st.Name LIKE '%Marriage%' OR st.Name LIKE '%Death%' THEN 'Vital Records' WHEN st.Name LIKE '%Church%' THEN 'Church Records' WHEN st.Name LIKE '%Cemetery%' OR st.Name LIKE '%Grave%' THEN 'Cemetery Records' ELSE 'Other Records' END as hierarchy, COUNT(DISTINCT ct.CitationID) as citation_count FROM SourceTable st LEFT JOIN CitationTable ct ON ct.SourceID = st.SourceID GROUP BY hierarchy HAVING citation_count > 0 ORDER BY citation_count DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN st.TemplateID = 0 THEN 'Free-Form Citations' ELSE 'Template-Based Citations' END || ' > ' || CASE WHEN st.Name LIKE '%Census%' THEN 'Census Records' WHEN st.Name LIKE '%Birth%' OR st.Name LIKE '%Marriage%' OR st.Name LIKE '%Death%' THEN 'Vital Records' WHEN st.Name LIKE '%Church%' THEN 'Church Records' WHEN st.Name LIKE '%Cemetery%' OR st.Name LIKE '%Grave%' THEN 'Cemetery Records' ELSE 'Other Records' END as hierarchy, COUNT(DISTINCT ct.CitationID) as citation_count FROM SourceTable st LEFT JOIN CitationTable ct ON ct.SourceID = st.SourceID GROUP BY hierarchy HAVING citation_count > 0 ORDER BY citation_count DESC

panels.title: TEST: Treemap - Citation Coverage

panels.description: Tests Arc Diagram data format: source, target, value (overlap years)

targets.queryText: WITH lifespans AS (SELECT p.PersonID, n.Given || ' ' || n.Surname as full_name, birth.Date as birth_date, death.Date as death_date FROM PersonTable p JOIN NameTable n ON n.OwnerID = p.PersonID AND n.IsPrimary = 1 LEFT JOIN EventTable birth ON birth.OwnerID = p.PersonID AND birth.EventType = 1 LEFT JOIN EventTable death ON death.OwnerID = p.PersonID AND death.EventType = 2 WHERE birth.Date IS NOT NULL AND birth.Date != '') SELECT elder.full_name as source, younger.full_name as target, CAST((julianday(elder.death_date) - julianday(younger.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) as overlap_years FROM lifespans elder JOIN lifespans younger ON younger.birth_date < elder.death_date WHERE elder.birth_date < younger.birth_date AND elder.death_date IS NOT NULL AND elder.death_date != '' AND overlap_years > 10 ORDER BY overlap_years DESC LIMIT 50
targets.rawQueryText: WITH lifespans AS (SELECT p.PersonID, n.Given || ' ' || n.Surname as full_name, birth.Date as birth_date, death.Date as death_date FROM PersonTable p JOIN NameTable n ON n.OwnerID = p.PersonID AND n.IsPrimary = 1 LEFT JOIN EventTable birth ON birth.OwnerID = p.PersonID AND birth.EventType = 1 LEFT JOIN EventTable death ON death.OwnerID = p.PersonID AND death.EventType = 2 WHERE birth.Date IS NOT NULL AND birth.Date != '') SELECT elder.full_name as source, younger.full_name as target, CAST((julianday(elder.death_date) - julianday(younger.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) as overlap_years FROM lifespans elder JOIN lifespans younger ON younger.birth_date < elder.death_date WHERE elder.birth_date < younger.birth_date AND elder.death_date IS NOT NULL AND elder.death_date != '' AND overlap_years > 10 ORDER BY overlap_years DESC LIMIT 50
